description: Judgments that recognise, define or apply privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21 (e.g. Puttaswamy, Govind, Kharak Singh). Mentioning privacy only in passing is partial.

Judgments laying down when anticipatory bail under s.438 CrPC may be granted and what conditions or time limits apply (e.g. Sibbia, Siddharam Mhetre, Sushila Aggarwal). The text of s.438 is also relevant.

query: default bail section 167(2) chargesheet not filed
description: Judgments on the indefeasible right to default/statutory bail when the chargesheet is not filed within 60/90 days under s.167(2) CrPC.
Judgments on dowry death under s.304B IPC and the presumption under s.113B Evidence Act ('soon before her death', cruelty for dowry). The statute text is relevant.
Judgments on s.498A IPC cruelty, especially on misuse, automatic arrest, or guidelines for such complaints.

query: guidelines for arrest and detention custodial violence
description: Judgments laying down safeguards for arrest and custody (e.g. D.K. Basu, Joginder Kumar, Arnesh Kumar). Cases that only mention custody are partial.

query: sexual harassment of women at workplace guidelines
description: Vishaka and later judgments on workplace sexual harassment, the POSH Act and internal complaints committees.
Judgments on the basic structure limit on Parliament's power to amend the Constitution (Kesavananda Bharati, Minerva Mills, Indira Gandhi v Raj Narain, etc.).

query: dying declaration sole basis of conviction
description: Judgments on whether and when a dying declaration alone can support a conviction, and how its reliability is tested.
Judgments on admissibility of electronic records and whether a s.65B(4) Evidence Act certificate is mandatory (Anvar P.V., Arjun Panditrao Khotkar). The section text is relevant.

query: daughter coparcener Hindu Succession Act amendment 2005
description: Judgments on daughters' coparcenary rights after the 2005 amendment to s.6 Hindu Succession Act (e.g. Vineeta Sharma, Prakash v Phulavati).
Judgments on maintenance for wives (and children) under s.125 CrPC: entitlement, quantum, refusal grounds. The section text is relevant.

query: dishonour of cheque section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act
description: Judgments on cheque bounce offences under s.138 NI Act: notice, limitation, legally enforceable debt, presumption under s.139.
Judgments on refusing information under the RTI Act as personal information under s.8(1)(j), and the public interest override.
Judgments applying or discussing the 'rarest of rare' test for the death sentence (Bachan Singh, Machhi Singh and later cases).

query: compensation for custodial death public law remedy
description: Judgments awarding compensation under Articles 32/226 for custodial death or violation of Article 21 by the State (Nilabati Behera, Rudul Sah, D.K. Basu).
Judgments on sedition under s.124A IPC and its limits under Article 19(1)(a) (Kedar Nath Singh and later cases).
Judgments on acquiring title by adverse possession: requirements (open, hostile, continuous for 12 years) and whether it can be used as a sword.

query: natural justice in departmental disciplinary inquiry
description: Judgments on the right to be heard, bias and fair procedure in disciplinary proceedings against employees.
Judgments on liability of doctors or hospitals for medical negligence (Bolam test, Jacob Mathew) and compensation awarded.
Judgments on computing compensation in motor accident claims: multiplier, future prospects, loss of dependency (Sarla Verma, Pranay Sethi).
Judgments on challenging an arbitral award under s.34 Arbitration and Conciliation Act: grounds, public policy, patent illegality, limitation.
Judgments on reservation in promotions for SC/ST in public employment (Indra Sawhney, M. Nagaraj, Jarnail Singh).
Judgments on the validity of instant triple talaq (Shayara Bano) and related questions of Muslim divorce.
The text of s.437 CrPC (bail in non-bailable offences) and judgments interpreting it.
The text of Article 14 and judgments on the reasonable-classification / arbitrariness tests for equality.

query: can police arrest without warrant for an offence punishable with less than seven years
description: Judgments and provisions on arrest without warrant for offences punishable up to 7 years: s.41/41A CrPC and Arnesh Kumar guidelines.

query: is a woman in a live-in relationship protected under the domestic violence act
description: Judgments on whether live-in partners fall within 'relationship in the nature of marriage' under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (e.g. Indra Sarma, D. Velusamy).

query: can a person be compensated for illegal detention through habeas corpus
description: Judgments granting relief or compensation for illegal detention in habeas corpus / writ proceedings.

query: does a terminally ill patient have the right to refuse life support
description: Judgments on passive euthanasia, living wills and the right to die with dignity (Aruna Shanbaug, Common Cause).
